metadata.description: Nine Claude Code plugins, each with commands that prove its claims: web app bugs, design, security, AWS costs, writing, long jobs, loops, recaps, agent docs.

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: Find what is broken in your running web app before users do. Each page bug comes with the steps to repeat it and a fix.

plugins.name: ui-ux-suite
plugins.description: Finds the design bugs in your CSS, JSX, HTML and Tailwind. Each one gets its file, line, measured value and exact fix. WCAG 2.2 contrast.

plugins.name: recap-studio
plugins.description: Understand what was done: one HTML page from your git session or a topic. Double-click to open. Works offline, no JavaScript.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Ranks what to cut on your AWS bill, three cuts first. Each price comes from AWS; the validator rejects a figure with no lookup record. Dry run by default.

plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: Give your agent a big job once. It asks every question first, saves the plan to a file, and re-runs your tests as proof. Works in any agent that reads skills.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: See which words make a draft sound like AI, then rewrite it in one of five voices. Optional 0 to 100 score. No network calls of its own.

plugins.name: loopify
plugins.description: Check a repeating Claude Code job in one line: OK, NEEDS YOU or STALE. loopify writes the brief and the /loop line, stop rule included.

plugins.name: secure-my-app
plugins.description: 65 security checks for your app before launch. Each hole comes with its proof, and a fix counts only when its VERIFY output changes.

plugins.name: contextify
plugins.description: Know when your agent instructions point at something gone. One AGENTS.md for all your agents and a local check that costs no tokens.
